tickets.subject: Removing a departed employee's seat

tickets.subject: Export file size limit reached unexpectedly
tickets.body: We tried exporting our full operations dataset for an annual review and got an error saying the file exceeds the size limit, though we didn't realise there was one until now - nothing in the export dialog mentioned it beforehand. Could you tell us what the actual limit is, and whether there's a way to split large exports automatically rather than us doing it manually by date range?

tickets.subject: API alternative for the large export problem
tickets.body: Following up on the export size limit from last month - we're now looking at pulling the data via the API in batches instead, since manual date-range splitting isn't sustainable for a report this size. Could you confirm the max response size per API call so we can plan the batching properly? We also had a quick look at how Storsund BI handles bulk data access, mostly for context on what's typical at this end of the market.

tickets.subject: Export and API workaround - settled for now
tickets.body: We've landed on a batching approach via the API that gets us the annual export data reliably, so the original size limit issue isn't blocking us anymore even though we never got a clear answer on raising it. Separately, we noticed the failure alert for the export job doesn't fire when the size limit is hit, which is really how this all started - but given we've moved to the API route anyway, it's low priority. Keeping half an eye on Storsund BI as part of general market awareness, nothing more than that for now.

tickets.subject: Following up - dashboard still slow
tickets.body: Wanted to check in on the slow-loading dashboard from a couple of weeks back, still an issue, worth flagging again in case it got lost.

I couldn't find a clean way to transfer ownership from the admin panel - it looks like I'd need to rebuild the schedules from scratch. Could you point me to the right process, or do it on your end? Not urgent, just want to get her account deactivated properly before month-end.

tickets.subject: Connector sync failing overnight - NetSuite source
tickets.body: Our NetSuite connector has failed its scheduled sync three nights running (24th, 25th, 26th Dec), throwing a generic 'source unreachable' error each time in the sync log. We've had to trigger manual syncs each morning to have current figures ready for the finance team. As part of next year's tooling review we've been asked to also look at Dashlume, but for now this is the platform we're on and would like it working reliably again. Could someone check what changed around the 24th?

tickets.subject: Dashboards showing stale figures again
tickets.body: Coming back to this - since the connector fix from December, the finance dashboards have started showing data that's a day or so out of date on some mornings, most recently the 25th and 27th of this month. It looks similar to the sync issue we reported before the patch. We've started refreshing manually before the 9am review, so there's no immediate urgency, but wanted it logged properly in case it points to something underneath the December fix that didn't fully take.

tickets.subject: New user invite not arriving — need to add analyst to account
tickets.body:
Hi,

I sent an invite to a new team member (anna.korhonen@[company].fi) earlier today and she has not received the email. Checked spam, nothing there. Can you resend or give me an alternative way to add her? We need her set up before end of week.

Thanks,
Mikael Hansen
Senior Analyst

tickets.subject: PDF export cutting off right side of wide tables
tickets.body:
Hello,

When exporting a report to PDF, any table wider than approximately 10 columns is being clipped on the right side. The data is there in the report view — it is only the PDF output that truncates it. We are sharing these exports externally so it is noticeable. Is there a page orientation or scaling setting we are missing, or is this a known rendering issue?

Mikael Hansen
Senior Analyst

tickets.subject: Provisioning new analyst seats - Enterprise plan
tickets.body: We're adding three new analysts to the finance reporting team starting next Monday and need seats provisioned under our Enterprise plan, ideally with the same dashboard and folder permissions as the rest of the team. Could you also confirm whether our current contract has spare seats available or whether we'll need to purchase additional ones? Happy to hop on a call if that's easier than email.

tickets.subject: Dashboard refresh delays during month-end close
tickets.body: For the second month-end running, our consolidated finance dashboard has taken 15-20 minutes to refresh, well past the couple of minutes we're used to, and twice this week it's timed out entirely before completing. This is landing right when the team needs the numbers most, which is not great timing. We're currently reviewing our BI tooling for next year, and Dashlume has come up partly because of stability concerns like this one. Could someone look into what's driving the slowdown?

tickets.subject: Seat count reconciliation ahead of renewal
tickets.body: Ahead of our autumn renewal we're reconciling licensed seats against actual usage and found four accounts still active for people who left the business in Q2. Could you deactivate the attached list and confirm the resulting seat count? We're also part-way through a proof-of-concept with Dashlume as part of the same renewal review, so getting our current numbers accurate matters more than usual this time round.

tickets.subject: Report builder templates failing to render - still
tickets.body: Coming back to the scheduling problem from April - the fix didn't fully hold. The leadership pack template still fails to render intermittently, most recently on the 15th and 18th, and we're back to spot-checking every scheduled send before it goes out to the board. We've built a manual verification step into our Monday routine so there's no crisis on our end, but wanted this documented properly given it's now come up twice. Our Dashlume evaluation is ongoing and this kind of thing is exactly what we're being asked to weigh up.

tickets.subject: Scheduled export time zone wrong
tickets.body: Our 6am scheduled export is arriving at what looks like 6am UTC rather than local time. Small thing but throws off our morning routine.

tickets.subject: API sandbox environment access
tickets.body: Requesting sandbox credentials to test an integration before we point it at production.

tickets.subject: Dashboard filter resets on refresh
tickets.body: A saved filter on our ops dashboard resets to default every time the page auto-refreshes. Have to reapply it manually each morning.

tickets.subject: API errors after year-end schema change
tickets.body: Since the new year fields were added, our API calls to the reports endpoint are throwing validation errors we haven't seen before.

tickets.subject: Export file corrupted on download
tickets.body: The last two exports we've downloaded open as corrupted files in Excel. Re-running the export doesn't help.

tickets.subject: Alert routing to wrong team
tickets.body: Separate from the export file issue we raised back in December, which we ended up working around ourselves, our stock alerts are now routing to the wrong distribution list after a recent reorg.

tickets.subject: Date filter defaulting to wrong range on report open
tickets.body:
Hi,

A report I built defaults to a 7-day range when opened, even though I saved it with a 30-day range selected. Every time someone opens it they have to manually reset the filter. Is there a way to lock the default, or is this a bug?

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

tickets.subject: Alert email format — HTML rendering broken
tickets.body:
Hello,

Alert notification emails are arriving as plain text — the HTML template is not rendering. Tables and formatting are all showing as raw code. This started after your update on 26 November. Can you fix?

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

tickets.subject: Report builder crashing on save with complex calculated fields
tickets.body:
Hello,

I am getting a consistent browser error when saving a report that contains more than four calculated fields with nested IF logic. The report saves partially — some fields are retained, others are lost — and I have to rebuild them each session. I have tried Chrome and Edge, same result. This has been happening for about two weeks and it is significantly slowing down our month-end prep.

This is the third separate issue I have raised in the past few months. I would appreciate a substantive update rather than a standard acknowledgement.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

tickets.subject: Sorting not applying correctly on grouped columns

Report builder sorting is broken again. Setting sort order on a grouped column reverts when I add a second group. This is similar to an issue from a few months back. Please fix.

VP Finance

tickets.subject: Report builder unusable for finance team — multiple active bugs
tickets.body:
Hello,

I need to escalate. The report builder is currently not fit for purpose for our finance team. We are dealing with: (1) the sorting issue from January which apparently was not fully fixed, (2) a new issue where adding a second data source to a report causes the first to drop, and (3) formula fields randomly losing their definitions overnight.

We have a board reporting deadline in 10 days and I cannot produce the outputs we need. I would like a call with someone technical this week, not a ticket that sits for six days.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

VP Finance

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

tickets.body:

VP Finance

tickets.subject: API timeouts on /reports/export endpoint
tickets.body: We're seeing intermittent timeouts on the /reports/export endpoint since early February, roughly one in fifteen calls, logged at our end with request IDs (happy to send the full list). It's forcing us to build retry logic around a call that used to be reliable. We've started benchmarking Storsund BI's API as part of a general vendor comparison this quarter, and consistency under load is one of the things we're testing for, so it'd help to understand what changed here.

tickets.subject: Export endpoint timeouts - back again
tickets.body: Following up on the timeout issue from February - the rate limit increase you applied helped for a couple of weeks but we're back to seeing the same 429s and occasional 504s on /reports/export, about one in twelve calls this time. We've added exponential backoff and a local cache on our side so the pipeline keeps running, so this isn't blocking us day to day. Logging it again mainly so it's on record - we're still mid-way through the Storsund BI benchmarking and this is one of the data points we're tracking.

tickets.subject: Cloning a report template across folders
tickets.body: Is there a way to clone an existing report template into a different folder while keeping its filters and layout intact? tickets.body: We've noticed the /data/query endpoint occasionally returns the same row twice across paginated calls when a report is large, which is throwing off our downstream row counts. We're de-duplicating on our side for now as a stopgap, but it'd be good to understand whether this is a known pagination edge case or something specific to our setup.

Would be good to get the naming convention consistent again when you have a moment.

tickets.body: Coming back to the duplicate row issue from April - our de-duplication step is still catching roughly the same number of repeats each week, so whatever's underneath wasn't fixed, just worked around on our end. It's not causing us problems day to day since the stopgap holds, so no need to prioritise this urgently. More of the team has moved reporting into Excel since spring, partly for reasons like this, so the API traffic on our side has dropped anyway.
